_comment: TicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side).

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, either X or O
_slots.{opponent_symbol}: The opponent's mark, either X or O
_slots.{cell}: A board cell number between 0 and 8

player_prompt.intro:
Ndinu Mchezaji {player_id} mu Tic Tac Toe.
Cholinga chanu ndi kuchinya mitatu mfululizo (wansi, juu, kapena mwa ulalo) pa bodo.
Pa zamu zanu, mwinafunika kusankha nambari ya mraba (0-8) mukufuna kuyika cholembera chanu.
Mwachitsanzo, '[4]' imayika cholembera chanu m'mtengano wa katikati pa bodo.
Ndi Mchezaji {player_id}, mudzakhala '{symbol}', pamene mphinzitsi wanu ndi '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Chita chomwe mwachita si ndi chomwe chinayenera.
invalid_move.out_of_range: {cell} si selo yoyenera. Ayenera kukhala pakati pa 0 ndi 8.

game_action.placed: Mchezaji {player_id} anaweka alama yake ({symbol}) mu seli {cell}.
